uncited: **View-Dependent Branch ($F_1$):** Predicts a single-channel intensity value $v$.
This branch captures lighting-related intensity variations.
**View-Independent Branch ($F_2$):** Predicts the intrinsic color basis $r$.
*   **Non-linearity:** Standard NeRF assumes linear radiance. sRGB images are non-linear due to ISP gamma correction and tone mapping.
NeRF is robust to zero-mean noise in RAW data but not to the blended noise in sRGB.
*   **View Inconsistency:** Applying 2D enhancement before NeRF training causes view inconsistency.
